If none of those are good, tell me two windows and I'll match Sergio's availability. Monica — can you please send the updated invite from the APAC calendar (so the event owner shows a Tokyo timezone)? Attaching updated-invite.ics and our latest demo-deck for reference.

Thanks again and apologies for the mix-up,
